translations.text: The command of the word of the Lord to Israel by the hand of his angel. Lay these things to your hearts.
I have loved you, says the Lord. And you said, "In what way have you loved us?" Was not Esau Jacob's brother? says the Lord. And I loved Jacob.
But Esau I hated, and I appointed his borders for destruction, and his inheritance to be handed over to desolation.

For he will say, "Idumea has been overthrown, but let us return and rebuild what was laid waste." Thus says the Lord Almighty: They will build, and I will tear down. And they will be called the border of lawlessness, and the people against whom the Lord is set forever.
And your eyes will see, and you will say, "The Lord has been magnified beyond the borders of Israel."

A son honors his father, and a servant his lord. If I am a father, where is my glory? And if I am a lord, where is the fear of me? says the Lord Almighty. Now you priests, who despise my name, you said, "In what way have we despised your name?"

For you bring to my altar and offer defiled bread, and you said, "In what way have we defiled it?" It is because you say, "The table of the Lord is contemptible," and you treat what is laid on it with contempt.

If you offer a blind animal to my altar, is that not evil? And if you offer a lame or sick one, is that not evil? Bring it to your ruler, then. Will he accept it, or will he show you favor? says the Lord Almighty.
And now plead before the face of your God, and he will be merciful to you. This was done by your hands. Will I show favor to any of you? says the Lord Almighty.

For the doors will be shut among you as well, and you will not kindle fire on my altar for nothing. I take no pleasure in you, says the Lord Almighty, and I will not accept a sacrifice from your hands.

For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name is glorified among the nations, and in every place incense is offered to my name, and a pure sacrifice. For my name is great among the nations, says the Lord Almighty.
But you profane it, for you say, "The table of the Lord is defiled, and what is laid on it, the food on it, is contemptible."

And you said, "This comes from hardship," and you sniffed at it [?], says the Lord Almighty. And you brought me what was stolen, and the lame and the sick, and offered them as a sacrifice. I will not accept it from your hands, says the Lord Almighty.

Cursed be the man who had the means, and had a ram in his flock, and was bound by his vow, and yet offered a blemished animal to the Lord. For I am a great King, says the Lord Almighty, and my name is renowned among the nations.
And now this commandment is for you, O priests.

If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to give glory to my name, says the Lord Almighty, then I will send the curse upon you. I will curse your blessing, and I will curse it. I will bring your blessing to nothing, and I will curse it, and it will not remain among you, because you did not take it to heart.
Behold, I will separate the shoulder from you, and I will scatter dung before your faces, the dung of your feasts, and I will bring you to it.
And you will know that I sent this commandment out to you, so that my covenant may be with the Levites, says the Lord Almighty.
For my covenant with him was one of life and of peace, and I gave him fear, so that he would fear me and stand in great awe before the face of my name.
For the law of truth was in his mouth, and no falsehood was found on his lips; they walked with me in peace, going uprightly, and he turned many away from the way of falsehood.
For the lips of the priest shall keep understanding, and they shall seek the law from his mouth, for he is the messenger of the Lord Almighty.
But you have turned aside from the way, and you have made many weak in the law, and you have made void the covenant of Levi, said the Lord Almighty.
And now I will make you despised and contemptible among all the nations, because you did not keep my ways but showed partiality to persons in the law.
Now, is there not one father of you all? Is there not one God who created you? Why has each one of you forsaken his brother, so as to profane the covenant of the law of your fathers?
Judah was forsaken and became an abomination in Israel and in Jerusalem, for Judah profaned the holiness of the Lord, which he loved, and went after foreign gods.
May the Lord destroy the man who did this, until he is brought low, from the dwellings of Jacob and from among those who bring offerings to the Lord Almighty.

And you did this thing, which I hated: you drenched the altar of the Lord with tears, and with weeping and sighing [?] was cut off. Is it then fitting to look on the sacrifice, or to receive an acceptable offering from your hands?
And you say, "Why?" Because the Lord bore witness between you and the wife of your youth, whom you forsook; yet she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.
And no other did so, and the remnant of his spirit. And you said, "What else does God seek but offspring?" So guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not forsake the wife of your youth.
And if you hate her and send her away, says the Lord God of Israel, then ungodliness will cover over your thoughts, says the Lord Almighty. So guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not forsake [?]

You who provoke God with your words, and you say, "How have we provoked you?" Because you said, "Everyone who does evil is good before the Lord, and he is pleased with them"; and, "Where is the God of justice?"

Behold, I will send out my messenger, and he will survey the way before my face. And suddenly the Lord whom you seek will come to his temple, and the messenger of the covenant whom you desire: behold, he is coming, says the Lord Almighty.
And who will endure the day of his coming? Or who will stand at his appearing? For he himself comes in like the fire of a furnace and like the herb of the washers.

And he shall sit and smelt and purify, as silver and gold; and he shall purify the sons of Levi and smelt them like gold and silver, and they shall be offerers of sacrifice to the Lord in righteousness.
And the sacrifice of Judah shall be pleasing to the Lord, and Jerusalem shall be as in the days of old and as in the former years.

And I will come to you in judgment, and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers and the adulterers, and those who swear falsely by my name, and those who withhold the wages of the hired labourer, who oppress widows and torment orphans, and who pervert the judgment of the stranger, and who do not fear me, says the Lord Almighty.
For I am the Lord your God, and I have not changed.

And you, sons of Jacob, have not turned away from the sins of your fathers; you have turned aside from my law and have not kept it. Return to me, and I will return to you, says the Lord Almighty. And you said: How shall we return?
Will a man defraud God? For you defraud me, and you said: In what have we defrauded you? For the tithes and the firstfruits are with you.
And you kept looking away [?]; you look away from me, and you defraud me. The year has come to an end.

And bring all the produce into the storehouses, and let there be spoil in your houses. Turn back from this, says the Lord Almighty, so that I may open for you the floodgates of heaven and pour out my blessing upon you until there is enough.
And I will provide for you for food, and I will not destroy the fruit of your land, and the vine of your field shall not fail, says the Lord Almighty.
And all nations shall call you blessed, for you shall be a delightful land, says the Lord Almighty.
You have made your words heavy against me, says the Lord, and you said: In what have we spoken evil against you?
For you said: It is vain to serve God; and what more do we gain because we have kept his ordinances, and because we walked as suppliants before the face of the Lord Almighty?
And now we call strangers blessed, and all who commit lawlessness are built up; they have opposed God and they live.

This evil those who feared the Lord spoke, each to his neighbour; and the Lord paid heed and heard, and a book of remembrance was written before him for those who fear the Lord and who serve the name of the Lord.
And they shall be mine, says the Lord Almighty, on the day that I make for succor, and I will favour them as a man favours his son who serves him.
And you shall return and see the difference between the righteous and the lawless, and between the one who serves God and the one who does not serve him.

For behold, the day is coming, burning like an oven, and it shall burn them; and all the foreigners and all who commit lawlessness shall be like reeds, and that coming day shall burn them up, says the Lord Almighty, and neither root nor branch shall be left to them.
And for you who fear my name the sun of righteousness shall shine forth, with healing under its wings, and you shall go out and leap like calves let loose from the stalls.
And you shall trample down the lawless, and they shall be ashes under your feet on the day that I shall act, says the Lord Almighty.
Remember the law of Moses my servant, as I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel: commandments and judgments.
And behold, I will send you Elijah the Tishbite before the coming of that great and appointed day of the Lord,
who shall turn the heart of the father to the son, and the heart of a man to his neighbour, lest I come and destroy the earth altogether.
